_note: 7 de-redundant cluster representatives (one per correlation cluster of the 20 valid factors; mutual corr<0.6).

factors.name: mispr_noa_disc
factors.rationale: Mispricing combined with low net operating assets (Hirshleifer bloat) and low issuance targets over-accruing over-valued firms.

factors.name: ebitda_value_quality
factors.rationale: EBITDA-to-market-EV value tilted toward quality profitability, penalizing equity issuance.

factors.name: cash_prof_accrual_quality
factors.rationale: Ball et al. cash-based profitability with low operating accruals (Sloan) and disciplined issuance = high-quality real earnings.

factors.name: quality_bloat_value
factors.rationale: Asness quality (profitability + safety) tilted to cheap sales-to-price and low balance-sheet bloat (NOA anomaly).

factors.name: issuance_mom_reversal
factors.rationale: Low equity and debt financing plus intermediate momentum, guarded against short-term reversal = capital discipline + underreaction.

factors.name: debt_discipline_value
factors.rationale: Low debt issuance and leverage with value and cash profitability captures conservatively financed cheap firms.

factors.name: coa_growth_quality
factors.rationale: Change in current operating assets and asset growth are overinvestment signals; cash profitability offsets them.
